subject: general
question: Lucknow is famous for which traditional art of embroidery?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chikankari work**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lucknow is famous for Chikankari work traditional art of embroidery**__.

 
 
• The word chikan itself means embroidery.
 
• It is one of Lucknow's best-known textile decoration styles.
